title: Unify EDHOC signature scheme: Python Ed25519 vs Rust Schnorr48
description: Cross-validation (bead project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.6.8.9, 2026-08-28) found Python EDHOC signs with RFC 9528 Ed25519 (64B) while Rust uses LICHEN Schnorr48 (48B, draft-lichen-schnorr-00). Signatures are in the transcript (th_3/th_4 -> master_secret), so identical seeds produce different master material and msg2/msg3 are mutually unparsable. NEEDS HUMAN DECISION: which signature profile is canonical for LICHEN EDHOC (Schnorr48 per draft-lichen-schnorr-00, or RFC 9528 Ed25519 for standards conformance), then align implementations. Filed as human-flagged decision bead.
